lines.en: - Is that you in there? - Yeah, it's me.
Oh my gosh, the bear ate Freddy. Bad bear!
You're not the boss of me.
He's webcasting directly to our audience.
And now on iCarly, I will sing a song all about my webcast.
I have a web show that I do.
- Take me to Juby with her. - No.
- Why not? - 'Cause you didn't commit a crime.
I'm sorry. No, no, no, no, no.
I'm sorry you don't look where you're going.
You know you probably just bruised my buttocks?
- Can I buy you the smoothie? - No, I have never seen such careless, stupid!
Hey, um, can we lower the microphone a little bit?
That was the last dang jar of bread and butter pickles in this store!
Were you going to buy this lollipop?
I could brand an elephant with this thing.
We're not going to walk in there and start hitting TV writers with a big buttery sock.
We're going to be professional and firm.
But if they deny stealing from my Carly, I'm going to get swingy with this thing.
Not unless I say it's okay.
You guys are the writers for Totally Terry?
What do you clowns think you are stealing our ideas?
Oh, we've never stolen an idea from anyone, so why don't you two little girls just go on?
Would it be a new car?
And you have to give it to me.
Oh, I just feel like spinning in a celebratory fashion.
Puckett, you just earned yourself triple detention.
They're paying me to do this.
I'll give you ten to release me.
Now, which of you Americans would like to be the first
to try a Canadian fat kick?
Yeah, I wouldn't mind being the first--
- Okay, Sam, take a bite. - Shut up!
Carly Shay has embarrassed herself yet again
by chickening out of her fight with Shelby Marks.
At least you can watch this animated video I've created
showing Carly as she truly is.
